title: Springdroid Adventure
description: Program a springdroid with boolean logic to jump over holes in the hull.
writeup:
## Approach

The springdroid always jumps exactly 4 tiles forward. We need to write boolean springscript using AND/OR/NOT with sensor registers to decide when to jump. The key is deriving the right logical formula.

## Part 1

With sensors A-D (1-4 tiles ahead), the droid should jump whenever there's a hole in the next 3 tiles AND the landing spot (D) is safe:

`J = (!A || !B || !C) && D`

This says: "if any of the next three tiles is missing, and I can land safely at distance 4, then jump." This takes 6 springscript instructions.

## Part 2

RUN mode adds sensors E-I (5-9 tiles). The same Part 1 logic fails because after landing on D, the droid might immediately face another gap it can't handle. We add a look-ahead check: after landing, the droid must be able to either walk forward (E is ground) or jump again (H, 4 tiles from D, is ground):

`J = (!A || !B || !C) && D && (E || H)`

This takes 10 springscript instructions, well within the 15-instruction limit.
